components.css: .ds-card{padding:32px;border:1px solid rgba(11,31,58,.09);border-radius:24px;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(11,31,58,.05),0 2px 8px rgba(11,31,58,.04);transition:transform .36s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1),box-shadow .36s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)}.ds-card:hover,.ds-card:focus-within{transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:0 6px 12px rgba(11,31,58,.06),0 28px 64px rgba(11,31,58,.14)}.ds-card h3{margin:0;font:700 1.5rem/1.12 'Red Hat Display',system-ui,sans-serif;letter-spacing:-.02em;color:#0B1F3A}.ds-card p{margin:10px 0 0;font:400 1rem/1.6 Inter,system-ui,sans-serif;color:#2E405A}

components.css: .ds-stat-chip{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:10px 16px 10px 10px;border-radius:18px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.72);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(14px) saturate(1.4);backdrop-filter:blur(14px) saturate(1.4);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.7);box-shadow:0 2px 4px rgba(11,31,58,.04),0 12px 32px rgba(11,31,58,.08)}.ds-stat-icon{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:12px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#E8F3FB,#E6FAF6);border:1px solid rgba(11,31,58,.09)}.ds-stat-chip strong{display:block;font:800 18px/1.1 'Red Hat Display',system-ui,sans-serif;letter-spacing:-.02em;color:#0B1F3A}.ds-stat-chip span:last-child{display:block;font:400 12px/1.3 Inter,system-ui,sans-serif;color:#55667D}

narrative.overview:
A medtech site that proves the device before it sells it. The page is a pale-sky field with deep-navy ink, hairline-bordered 24px cards and generous section spacing. The one thing that moves continuously is the scan ring sweeping the iris in the hero; everything else holds still until it is scrolled to or touched. Clinical trust comes from clarity, whitespace and restraint, not stock imagery or hype.

The audience is a hospital, lab or outreach-programme buyer weighing evidence, so the system leads with measured facts and keeps decoration to faint ECG and molecule line motifs at 4-6% opacity. Teal marks measured things; blue carries structure and links; a single orange pill carries the one action, BOOK A DEMO. Dark mode is a deep-navy night, never black.
keyCharacteristics: Pale-sky canvas, navy ink, clinical blue structure, teal for measured marks, one orange for action.
Pill buttons and chips; 24px cards with a hairline border and a soft navy-tinted shadow.
Glass (translucent + blur) only on the scrolled header, hero stat chips and floating UI.
One continuous motion (the scan ring); all else is reveal-on-scroll and state response, off under reduced motion.
Every text/background pair is AA in both themes; 44px touch targets on touch screens.

rules.name: The One Orange Rule
rules.body: Orange fills belong to BOOK A DEMO and the primary action of a surface. Orange as text or hover accent uses the darker Orange Ink, never the fill color, and never competes with a primary button in the same viewport.

rules.name: The Teal Means Measured Rule
rules.body: Teal marks only things the product measures or confirms. It is not a second decorative accent.

rules.name: The Navy-On-Orange Rule
rules.body: Anything sitting on the orange fill uses navy text. White text on orange is not allowed.

rules.name: The Not-Black Rule
rules.body: Dark mode is #07121F-based. Pure black is never a surface or text color.

rules.name: The Tight Display Rule
rules.body: Red Hat Display headings always carry negative letter-spacing (-0.02em to -0.04em); Inter text never does.

rules.name: The Gradient Once Rule
rules.body: Gradient text (blue to teal) appears once: "Early Detection" in the Home H1.

rules.name: The Soft Lift Rule
rules.body: Shadows are diffuse and blurred (two layers, large radius). Hard offset or zero-blur shadows are not used.

rules.name: The Glass Is Rare Rule
rules.body: Backdrop blur is reserved for the scrolled header and floating UI; content cards sit on solid surfaces.

dos: Do keep BOOK A DEMO as the single orange fill in a viewport, with navy text (#0B1F3A on #F47B30).
Do use teal only for measured or positive marks, and Orange Ink / Teal Ink (never the fills) when the color is text.
Do use Red Hat Display with negative tracking for headings and Inter for everything else.
Do build cards at 24px radius with a 1px hairline and the Rest shadow; lift on hover with the Lifted shadow.
Do let the scan ring be the only continuous motion in the first viewport; add other motion as reveal or state response only.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion (animations and transitions collapse, reveals show immediately) and keep focus visible (2px orange, 3px offset).
Do keep dark mode on #07121F-based surfaces with neutral black shadows, and verify AA in both themes.
Do use hairline-separated rows or lists instead of a grid of identical cards when content is a list.
donts: Don't put white text on the orange fill, or use orange fills for anything but primary actions.
Don't use gradient text anywhere except the Home H1 "Early Detection".
Don't apply backdrop blur to content cards; glass is for the scrolled header and floating UI.
Don't use pure black for dark-mode surfaces or text.
Don't use hard offset shadows or tinted navy shadows on dark surfaces.
Don't reintroduce a stock-doctor hero, an identical icon-card grid, or a testimonial carousel; none exists in the evidence.
Don't add more than faint (4-6%) ECG or molecule line motifs as ornament.
